spans.s:
n. (-तु)
Lac, a red dye or animal pigment, analogous to cochineal.
E.
जन to be born, उ Uṇādi affix, and न changed to त; also with कन् added जतुक.

ind.
1 Sometimes, occasionally.
2 A particle of prohibition.
3 Of doubt.
4 Of contempt or abuse.
E.
जै to waste or decay, तुन् aff.

n. (-कं)
1 Lac: see the last.
2 Asafoetida.
f. (-का)
1 A plant, commonly Chakawat:
2 A bat; also जतूका.
3 A fragrant substance.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-का)
1 A fragrant substance.
2 A bat.
E.
जन to be born, ऊकच् affix, and न changed to त; also with the pen. short जतुका.

n. (-कं)
Asafoetida.
E.
जतुक the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.

m. (-कृत्)
A fragrant substance: see the last.
E.
जतु lac, and कृत what makes or affords; the lac insect building its nest in this tree.

f. (-नी)
A bat.

m. (-कः)
A man at chess or backgammon, &c.
E.
जतु lac, and पुत्त्रक as it were, a son, being coloured with lac.

m. (-णिः)
A mole, a natural mark on the body.
E.
जतु, and मणि a gem.

m. (-सः)
Lac, the dye.
E.
जतु, and रस juice.

n. (-त्रु)
The collar bone, the clavicle.
E.
जन to be born. Uṇādi affix रु, and न changed to त; also with कन added जत्रुक n. (-कं).

n. (-कं)
Red arsenic.
E.
जतु, and अश्म a stone, कन् affix, like a stone of lac.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Born, engendered.
2 A child, offspring.
3 Apparent, manifest.
4 Produced, caused, occasioned.
5 Felt, entertained.
6 Inspired with, affected by.
n. (-तं)
1 Kind, sort, class, species.
2 Multitude, collection.
3 Individuality, specific condition.
4 Birth, production.
E.
जन to be born, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Born.
m. (-कः)
A mendicant.
n. (-कं)
Astrological calculation of a nativity.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-निः)
A leech.

n. (-र्म्मं)
1 A ceremony performed, when the navel string is divided, touching the infant's tongue thrice with ghee, with appropriate prayers, &c.
2 Delivery, &c. of a new-born infant.
E.
जात born, and कर्म्म rite.

mf. (-न्तः-न्ती)
A child that has got a tooth.
E.
जात, and दन्त a tooth.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Confiding, believing, inspired with confidence.
E.
जात, and प्रत्यय trust.

mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं)
Enraged, vexed, angry.
E.
जात, and मष wrath.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
What is just born, or merely born
n. (-त्रं)
As soon as born, the instant of birth.
E.
जात, and मात्रच् aff.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
Embodied, assuming shape or form
n. (-पं)
Gold.
E.
जात produced, and रूप form.

m. (-दाः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
जात born, वेद a Veda, असि Uṇādi affix; or जात kind, sort, and विद to know, or comprehend, affix as before: one legend makes the Vedas to have issued from the mouth of AGNI.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Wearied, exhausted.
E.
जात, and श्रम fatigue.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Desirous, wishing for.
E.
जात, and स्पृहा wish.

mfn. (-र्द्दः-र्द्दी-र्द्दं)
Becoming attached to or fond of.
E.
जात, and हार्द्द affection.

mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः)
Offending, sinning, committing any fault.
E.
जात, and आगस् sin; also जातापराध, जातदोष, &c.

f. (-त्या)
A mother, a woman who has borne a child.
E.
जात born, (by whom,) अपत्य offspring.

mfn. (-श्रुः-श्रुः-श्रु)
Weeping, shedding tears.
E.
जात, and अश्रु a tear.

f. (-तिः)
1 Kind, sort, species, class, tribe.
2 Birth, production.
3 Lineage, race, family.
4 A fire place, a chimney.
5 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.)
6 A plant: see काम्पिल्ल.
7 A kind of poetical metre.
8 A rhetorical ornament.
9 (In Arithmetic,) Assimilation, as विशेषजाति assimilation of the difference, शेषजाति of the remainder.
10 Proximate cause or occurrence of disease, &c.
f. (-तिः or -ती)
1 Great flowered jasmin, (J. grandiflorum.)
2 Mace, nutmeg.
f. (-तिः)
The flower of the jasmin.
E.
जन to be born, affix क्तिच्, and occasionally ङीष् added.

n. (-शं)
Nutmeg.
E.
जाति or जाती mace, and कोश or कोष sheathe; hence also जातिकोष, जातीकोश or जातीकोष.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Distinction or nature of caste or tribe.
2 Special or generic property.
E.
त्व added to जाति; also with तल्, जातिता.

m. (-र्म्मः)
1 The duty of caste, as sacred study of the Brahman, battle of the Kṣatriya, &c.
2 Generic or specific property.
E.
जाति, and धर्म्म duty.

n. (-लं)
Nutmeg.
E.
जाति or जाती mace, and फल fruit; also जातीफल; also जातिकोष, जाति or जाती, and जातिपुष्पं.

m. (-शः)
Loss of caste.
E.
जाति, and भ्रंश injury.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Forbidden, improper, causing loss of caste.
n. (-रं)
Doing any act prohibited to a particular caste.
E.
जातिभ्रंश, and कर what makes.

n. (-त्रं)
1 Species, genus.
2 Caste only, not the performance of its especial duties.
E.
जाति, and मात्र only.

n. (-णं)
1 Specific or generic distinction or characteristic.
2 Mark of tribe or caste.
E.
जाति, and लक्षण indication.

n. (-रं)
Innate or instinctive hostility.
E.
जाति, and वैर enmity.

n. (-ण्यं)
Inconsistency, incompatibility, conduct or quality at variance with tribe or species.
E.
जाति, and वैलक्षण्य inconsistency.

m. (-बः)
Specific or generic character or nature.
E.
जाति, and स्वभाव nature.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
One who recollects his condition in a former life.
E.
जाति, and स्मर who remembers.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Outcaste, void of caste.
E.
जाति, and हीन void of.

f. (-त्री)
Mace.
E.
जाती, and पत्री a leaf.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating to any species, belonging to any tribe or order, &c.
E.
जाति, and छ aff.

n. (-सं)
Gem myrrh.
E.
जाती nutmeg, and रस juice.

m. (-नः)
A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin.
E.
जातु sometimes, धान possessing, from धा with ल्युट् or युच्; otherwise यातुधान.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Made, &c. of lac, any artificial form or condition of it.
E.
जतु lac, अण् affix, and षुक् augment.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Rites performed at birth.
E.
जात, and इष्टि sacrifice.

m. (-क्षः)
A bullock.
E.
जात born, उक्ष an ox.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
1 Well-born, legitimate, born of parents of the same caste.
2 Best, excellent.
3 Pleasing, beautiful.
4 Rectangular.
E.
जाति family, &c. यत् aff.

n. (-रं)
Interval of difference of caste.
E.
जाति, and अन्तर interval.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Born blind.
E.
जाति birth, अन्ध blind.
